info.title: BKK Futar Universal API
info.description: Access planned and real-time public transportation data from BKK Futar for Budapest, including stops, arrivals, departures, schedules, vehicles, alerts, references, and bicycle rental stations.

get.summary: Get Arrivals And Departures For Stop
